name: EmilyChat
summary: Embeddable Emily customer-support chat for iOS.
description: Embeddable customer-support chat, powered by a WKWebView that hosts the Emily web bundle from the Level3 CDN. The native layer owns lifecycle, a small JSON bridge, and a typed Swift API; all UI ships from the web bundle, so visual changes go live without an App Store release.
